column1: # MARKER CLASSES -- the family a marker belongs to, and what that family looks
# like by default.
# A row in markers.tsv names its class; the class supplies the default SHAPE and
# COLOUR, and the row overrides either one.
# ⭐ WHY CLASSES EXIST (DL J7, 2026-08-04). Every marker used to be a confidence
# claim, and that narrowness was genuinely the feature: you can ask "what is
# unconfirmed across this whole site" only while every row answers the same
# question. When terminology arrived it was nearly built as a SECOND, parallel
# family -- two mechanisms for one concept -- because the table had no way to say
# which KIND a row was. Michael's ruling: it IS a marker, put it in markers, you
# have found CLASSES. The report groups by class, so the confidence question stays
# answerable no matter how many glossary terms a site marks.
# ADDING A MARKER is a row in markers.tsv. ADDING A WHOLE FAMILY is a row here.
# Neither is a code change and neither is a CSS change -- the class colour is
# emitted as generated CSS by docrender/markers.py.
# COLUMNS
# class    the token a markers.tsv row names
# shape    default shape for the family: box · plain · strike · soft
# color    default colour: any token from the canonical palette or from
#          theme/colors.tsv, or a literal hex/oklch
# label    what this family MEANS. For the reader of this file and the report.
# 🔴 `terminology` ASKED FOR `accent-soft` FOR A MONTH AND IT WAS NEVER LEGIBLE.
# Corrected 2026-08-05 to `accent-2`.
# `accent-soft` is a WASH -- the tinted BACKGROUND behind an accent chip. As
# letters it measures 1.29 against the eos dark canvas and 1.12 against the
# light one, where it needs 4.5. It was the wrong kind of token, not merely a
# dim one.
# ⚠️ AND THE BUG SURVIVED BECAUSE IT NEVER RENDERED. The engine's token list did
# not know any canonical name, so `accent-soft` was refused every build and the
# markers quietly fell back to body colour -- which looked like a deliberate
# design. A wrong value that cannot render is a wrong value nobody sees. The
# list is derived now (see markers.py) so the next wrong token will actually
# show up wrong.
# `accent-2` measures 6.63 canvas / 5.86 card in dark and 5.81 / 6.52 in light,
# and on the eos palette it is the console's TRACKED violet -- a defined term is
# a thing the house has already decided about, which is what that colour means
# on the desk.
# ⚠️ STILL NAMED IN EXACTLY ONE CELL, and that is the property worth protecting.
# Changing this family's colour must never require touching code or CSS. The
# moment a second surface hardcodes it, that promise is dead.
class
confidence
